snippet.title: Diablo IV | Season of Infernal Chaos | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hunt for Chaos Armor with max power and rare affixes. Unleash Chaos Perks to redefine your build. Face the reworked Infernal Hordes and dive into Chaos Rifts for elite loot and XP.

Season of Infernal Chaos arrives in #DiabloIV September 23. 

Details await: http://blizz.ly/4nzqwOZ
